notes: Full description: pkix-lint/src/deviation.rs Deviation struct at lines 65-140. The field 'target_lint: &'static str' (line 78) requires a static lifetime, forcing callers to use string literals. All other string fields (id, justification, authorized_by, evidence_uri) are String. This asymmetry is inconsistent and creates a usability trap: a caller who constructs lint IDs at runtime (e.g., from configuration files or databases) cannot populate target_lint without Box::leak() or similar lifetime-extension tricks. The lint_id field in Finding (lib.rs:372) is also &'static str, which is consistent because lint IDs come from Lint::id() which is &'static str. But for deviation configuration loaded at runtime (YAML, JSON, database), requiring &'static str for target_lint forces all deviation configurations to be compiled in. Fix: Change target_lint to String, and find_deviation() signature to accept &str. The DeviationStore::active_for_lint() method at line 461 already takes &'a str. This is a breaking API change; document in changelog. Priority: P2 (API usability — forces compile-time-only deviation configuration).
title: FINDING (duplicate of PKIX-m75.12): Deviation::target_lint is &'static str but Deviation::id is String
